lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to come up with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders, but Moses alone approaches Him.
Moses writes down all the LORD's words and builds an altar at the base of the mountain with twelve pillars.
Young men sacrifice young bulls, and Moses splatters the blood of the covenant on the pillars.
Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders see the God of Israel, and they sing and dance.
Moses goes up the mountain with Joshua and stays forty days and forty nights.
